name: MainPlace Mall
summary: Spacious shopping center featuring department stores, a gym, a movie theater & a bowling alley.
demographics: Westfield MainPlace primarily serves middle-income families and Hispanic households in central Orange County, drawing from Santa Ana and surrounding communities with diverse age demographics. The trade area encompasses a mix of working families, young professionals, and value-conscious shoppers seeking accessible mainstream retail and entertainment options. Visitors typically exhibit shopping patterns centered on convenience, family activities, and affordable fashion, with strong weekend traffic driven by the center's entertainment venues and dining options.
description: Westfield MainPlace is an indoor regional shopping destination anchored by Macy's and JCPenney, featuring nearly 200 stores spanning top brands in fashion, beauty, dining, and entertainment. Located at the convergence of the 5, 22, and 57 freeways in the heart of Orange County, the center offers comprehensive amenities including 24 Hour Fitness Super Sport, Ashley Furniture HomeStore, Round 1 Bowling & Amusement, Funparx, and Picture Show Theater.
